HandsFreeOS Milestone 1 · Clean & airy
Accent #2D69D8 · Hanken Grotesk + JetBrains Mono · 8/12 px radii · 36 px controls.
Use the Accent and Theme chips above any screen to preview the whole system recolored or in dark mode. Every screen is clickable: the workspace switcher, invites, role changes, passkeys and audit filters all work.

Sample data only: Go Biz Help is the agency organization; Lone Star HVAC & Roofing, Bayou Plumbing Co. and Summit Roofing are fictional client workspaces. People, emails and times are placeholders. The Touch ID sheet is a mock of the device prompt.

Reserved, not drawn: a persistent 'Ask HandsFreeOS' button joins the sidebar footer in Milestone 4 (assistant), and Customers / Pipeline / Inbox / Calendar join the nav as they ship. The Milestone 1 nav shows only what Milestone 1 delivers.
